shortDescription: This module configures and manages cloud backups on IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: all
options.description: Specifies to delete all cloud backup generations. Applies when I(state=absent) to delete a backup. The parameters I(all) and I(generation) are mutually exclusive. Either I(generation) or I(all) is required to delete cloud backup.

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: full
options.description: Specifies that the snapshot generation for the volume should be a full snapshot. Applies when I(state=present).

options.name: generation
options.description: Specifies the snapshot generation ID that needs to be deleted for the volume. If the specified generation is for a snapshot operation that is in progress, that snapshot operation is canceled. Applies when I(state=absent) to delete a generation of a volume backup. The parameters I(all) and I(generation) are mutually exclusive. Either I(generation) or I(all) is required to delete cloud backup.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates (C(present)) or deletes (C(absent)) a cloud backup.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.spectrum_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: volume_UID
options.description: Specifies the volume UID to delete a cloud backup of the volume. The value for a volume UID must be a value in the range 0-32. The parameters I(volume_UID) and I(volume_name) are mutually exclusive. Applies when I(state=absent) to delete cloud backups.

options.name: volume_name
options.description: Specifies the volume name for the volume being backed up. The parameters I(volume_name) and I(volumegroup_name) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: volumegroup_name
options.description: Specifies the volumegroup name for the volume to back up. The parameters I(volume_name) and I(volumegroup_name) are mutually exclusive. Applies when I(state=present) to create cloud backups of all the volume group members. Cloud backup must be enabled on all the volume group members to execute this.
